name: Dakhla

info.best_time_val: Mar – Oct for wind; year-round for landscapes

overview.title: Welcome to Dakhla — lagoon, wind and desert shore
overview.p1: Dakhla sits on a long sand peninsula in Morocco’s far south, where Saharan dunes meet a vast Atlantic lagoon. The town is modest; the landscape is the destination — flat turquoise water, steady trade winds, and landmarks like the White Dune and Dragon Island that feel almost unreal.
overview.p2: Riders come for kitesurf and wingfoil on glass-smooth shallows. Everyone else comes for boat trips on the lagoon, oyster tastings, desert tracks and evenings on the corniche. Allow three to five days if you want both wind sports and slow exploration.

places.title: Must-visit places in Dakhla
places.subtitle: Lagoon, White Dune, Dragon Island, wind spots and the working port.

lagune.title: Dakhla Lagoon
lagune.desc: A 40 km turquoise lagoon between the Sahara and the Atlantic — the heart of Dakhla and a world kitesurf stage.

dune_blanche.title: White Dune (Dune Blanche)
dune_blanche.desc: A pure white sand dune rising from the lagoon; at high tide it sits in turquoise water like an island.

ile_dragon.title: Dragon Island
ile_dragon.desc: A rocky islet in the lagoon whose silhouette looks like a sleeping dragon; boat or low-tide access.

kitesurf.title: Kitesurf & Wingfoil Spots
kitesurf.desc: Flat water, steady trade winds and camps along the lagoon for beginners and advanced riders.

port.title: Fishing Port & Corniche
port.desc: Working harbour, evening promenade and the everyday face of the peninsula town.

sources_asnaa.title: Asnaa Hot Springs
sources_asnaa.desc: Natural warm pools inland from the lagoon — a quiet contrast after wind and sand.

foum_el_bouir.title: Foum El Bouir (Ocean Side)
foum_el_bouir.desc: Atlantic wave spot on the ocean side of the peninsula for surf and advanced sessions.

huitres.title: Oyster Farms
huitres.desc: Lagoon oyster farms with tastings — a simple, local way to taste the bay.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-day plan in Dakhla
itinerary.subtitle: Lagoon orientation, signature landscapes, then wind or ocean.

day1.title: Lagoon & town
day1.desc: Corniche, port and a first lagoon viewpoint or short boat hour.

day2.title: White Dune & Dragon Island
day2.desc: Organised 4x4 or boat day for the two signature landmarks.

day3.title: Wind sports or ocean side
day3.desc: Kitesurf lesson or free ride, or Foum El Bouir for Atlantic waves.

directory.title: Find Your Ideal Stay in Dakhla
directory.subtitle: Lagoon camps, hotels in town and stays near the kite spots.

eat.title: Where to Eat in Dakhla
eat.subtitle: Fresh fish, lagoon oysters and simple tables.

roudani.title: Fish restaurants
roudani.desc: Grilled catch near the port and centre.

maryam.title: Oyster tasting
maryam.desc: Short visits and tastings at lagoon farms.

zitoune.title: Camp restaurants
zitoune.desc: Meals at lagoon camps after sessions.

jardin.title: Simple local tables
jardin.desc: Everyday Moroccan plates away from the camps.

fassia.title: Hotel restaurants
fassia.desc: Reliable options if you stay in town or at a larger lodge.

moha.title: Port-side fish
moha.desc: Fresh from the harbour when boats are in.

bacha.title: Town café stop
bacha.desc: Coffee and a pause between errands.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Town is small; lagoon camps need transfer. 4x4 or agency for White Dune and desert tracks. Agree prices clearly.

bargain.title: Wind & sun
bargain.desc: Trade winds are strong. Use high SPF, a windbreaker and secure loose items near the shore.

water.title: Water & cash
water.desc: Carry bottled water on outings. Cards are limited outside larger hotels — keep dirhams for taxis and small stops.

daytrips.title: Best outings from Dakhla
daytrips.subtitle: Signature lagoon loops and longer desert tracks.

tiout.title: White Dune & lagoon loop
tiout.desc: Half-day 4x4 or boat outing combining the White Dune and lagoon viewpoints.

antiatlas.title: Imlili sebkha
antiatlas.desc: Salt flats and natural desert pools south of Dakhla — a full-day track with a local driver.

taliouine.title: Ocean-side beaches
taliouine.desc: Foum El Bouir and wild Atlantic stretches for surf and empty sand.

agadir.title: Tropic of Cancer marker
agadir.desc: A symbolic stop on the peninsula road — quick photo and sense of latitude.

q1.question: How many days do I need in Dakhla?
q1.answer: Three days cover the lagoon highlights and one excursion. Five days suit kitesurf progress plus White Dune and Dragon Island at a relaxed pace.

q2.question: Is Dakhla only for kitesurfers?
q2.answer: No. The lagoon, White Dune, Dragon Island, oyster farms and desert tracks work for non-riders. Wind sports are the main draw, not the only one.

q3.question: How do I get to Dakhla?
q3.answer: Dakhla has a domestic airport (VIL) with flights from major Moroccan cities. Overland, it is a long drive or bus from Agadir or Laâyoune.

q4.question: When is the best time to visit?
q4.answer: For wind sports, spring through early autumn brings the steadiest trade winds. Winter is milder for sightseeing and can still offer sessions.
